usefulness.rationale: The dossier firmly establishes the subject: Anders Danielsson, Skanska's President and CEO (since 2018, succeeding Johan Karlström), a 26-year company veteran tapped to shore up U.S. operations, with well-cited recent activity (3,000-job workforce reduction, management realignment naming Richard Kennedy, commentary on data centres, AI use, margins, and upcoming 2025/2026 report presentations and individual-meeting availability). A reader could reasonably prepare for a meeting from this. However, the career section contains a serious wrong-person contamination: it presents 'Head of the Swedish Security Service 2007–2012' as supported, citing the Wikipedia Swedish Security Service article — that is the Swedish civil servant of the same name (the Q4353002 confusable), and it is impossible for someone employed at Skanska since 1991. The dossier also never states its own limits (no explicit 'what we don't know' framing; many claims sit at claimed/contested without explanation), and several claims rest on name-only quotes that cannot support what is asserted.
